Cardograph Plus

Cardograph Plus provides access to the complete Cardograph application. The United States list prices are:

  1. USD 4.99 per month for monthly access.
  2. USD 39.99 per year for annual access.

These are auto renewing subscriptions. Cardograph has no weekly plan, lifetime purchase, or lifetime access. Prices, taxes, currency, and availability can vary by country or store. The price and terms displayed by Apple or Google on the purchase confirmation screen control the purchase.

Three day trial

Apple or Google can offer an introductory three day free trial to an eligible new subscriber. Trial eligibility is determined by the store account and subscription group. Cardograph does not create a separate local trial and cannot grant another introductory trial when the store reports that an account is ineligible.

If the store confirms a free trial, the selected subscription automatically becomes paid when the trial ends unless you cancel before the store's stated deadline. The purchase confirmation screen shows eligibility, the expected charge date, the recurring price, and the renewal period. Review that screen before confirming.

Renewal, cancellation, and access

A subscription renews automatically for the selected monthly or annual period until canceled through Apple or Google. You can cancel at any time through the subscription settings for the store account that made the purchase. Unless the store, a refund, or applicable law provides otherwise, cancellation stops the next renewal and access continues until the end of the current paid or trial period.

Uninstalling Cardograph, logging out, or deleting a Cardograph account does not cancel an Apple or Google subscription. You must cancel the subscription separately through the applicable store.

When subscription access ends, Cardograph can restrict collection features. The collection remains preserved unless you delete it, and the locked access screen continues to provide collection export and purchase restoration. Cardograph can check subscription status when the app opens, returns to the foreground, or connects to the service.

Refunds and billing support

Apple processes purchases made through the App Store. Google processes purchases made through Google Play. Refund eligibility and decisions are governed by the store's policies and applicable law. NABURA LABS LLC does not receive your complete payment card number and cannot promise that a store will approve a refund.

For an Apple purchase, use Apple's refund process. For a Google Play purchase, use Google Play's refund process.

Camera and card recognition

Cardograph processes live camera frames on the device to locate cards and suggest likely catalog matches. Camera photos and video are not saved or uploaded by Cardograph.

Recognition results require your review. Lighting, glare, angle, card orientation, card language, print quality, device performance, catalog coverage, and visible text can affect results. Cardograph does not guarantee that it will identify every card or that an identity suggestion is correct.

Cardograph does not authenticate cards, detect counterfeits, assign grades, establish condition, or replace review by a qualified professional.

Prices and collection value

Prices shown in Cardograph are informational reference estimates obtained through third party catalog data. A displayed reference can be delayed, stale, incomplete, unavailable, or incorrectly mapped to a printing or finish. Condition, language, printing, fees, shipping, taxes, marketplace demand, and the actual transaction can produce a different value.

Cardograph does not provide a formal appraisal, financial advice, investment advice, tax advice, or a guaranteed sale price. Do not make a financial decision based only on a Cardograph value.

Trades

Cardograph can record completed or planned card trades and agreed values. It does not operate a marketplace, match trading partners, transfer money, arrange shipping, authenticate items, provide escrow, or resolve disputes. You are responsible for reviewing the other party, the cards, the agreed terms, safety, shipping, payment, taxes, and compliance with law.

Offline storage, cloud synchronization, and backups

Cardograph stores collection information on the device and synchronizes a signed in collection with the cloud. Some features need internet access, including initial catalog downloads, fresh price references, account sign in, synchronization, purchase verification, and restoration.

Synchronization can be delayed or fail. If two devices change independently, Cardograph can ask you to choose which collection version to keep. You are responsible for maintaining an export of important collection information. Cardograph provides CSV and JSON export tools, but cannot guarantee that local files, device backups, cloud services, or third party destinations will always remain available.

Uninstalling Cardograph can remove local information. Other offline devices can retain copies after an account is deleted until those local copies are erased.

Account deletion

You can delete your Cardograph account and cloud collection from Settings. Account deletion removes the active Cardograph account, its cloud collection, and its Cardograph RevenueCat customer profile.

Account deletion does not automatically cancel an Apple or Google subscription, delete purchase records maintained by Apple or Google, erase offline copies on another device, or remove an export you saved or shared elsewhere. Account deletion is intended to be permanent. Export any information you want to keep before confirming.
